label: Gazebo
literalRoomDescription: This is a gazebo in the midst of a formal garden. It is cool and restful here. A tea table adorns the center of the gazebo.
safeSceneProfile: Cool white gazebo within the cave garden, with separate tea table. No tea-table contents or unicorn unless currently observed.

sourceText:
** U.S. News and Dungeon Report **

FAMED ADVENTURER TO EXPLORE GREAT UNDERGROUND EMPIRE

Our correspondents report that a world-famous and battle-hardened adventurer has been seen in the vicinity of the Great Underground Empire. Local grues have been reported sharpening their (slavering) fangs....
